mapper.select: SELECT d.ID AS DISCOUNT_ID, d.ONSALE_YN, d.NAME, d.TYPE, d.START_DATE, d.END_DATE, d.DISCOUNT_TYPE, d.DISCOUNT_VALUE, d.MAX_DISCOUNT, d.DESCRIPTION, d.MIN_PRICE, dt.ID AS TARGET_ID, dt.DISCOUNT_ID, dt.TARGET_TYPE, dt.TARGET_ID FROM DISCOUNT_TB d JOIN DISCOUNT_TARGET_TB dt ON d.ID = dt.DISCOUNT_ID WHERE ((dt.TARGET_TYPE = 'CATEGORY' AND dt.TARGET_ID = #{productCategoryInfo.id}) OR (dt.TARGET_TYPE = 'PRODUCT' AND dt.TARGET_ID = #{productNumber})) AND d.START_DATE <= SYSDATE AND d.END_DATE >= SYSDATE

WITH discounted_products AS ( SELECT dtt.TARGET_ID AS product_number, dt.DISCOUNT_VALUE, dt.DISCOUNT_TYPE, dt.MIN_PRICE FROM DISCOUNT_TB dt JOIN DISCOUNT_TARGET_TB dtt ON dt.ID = dtt.DISCOUNT_ID WHERE dt.ONSALE_YN = 'Y' AND dt.START_DATE <= SYSDATE AND dt.END_DATE >= SYSDATE ), calculated_discounts AS ( SELECT dp.product_number, dp.DISCOUNT_TYPE, dp.DISCOUNT_VALUE, CASE WHEN dp.DISCOUNT_TYPE = 'P' THEN p.PRICE * (dp.DISCOUNT_VALUE / 100) WHEN dp.DISCOUNT_TYPE = 'A' THEN dp.DISCOUNT_VALUE ELSE 0 END AS discount_amount FROM discounted_products dp JOIN PRODUCT_TB p ON dp.product_number = p.PRODUCT_NUMBER ), max_discounts AS ( SELECT product_number, MAX(discount_amount) AS max_discount_amount FROM calculated_discounts GROUP BY product_number ) SELECT p.PRODUCT_NUMBER, p.NAME, p.DESCRIPTION, p.PRICE, p.QUANTITY, pf.FILE_PATH, sp.ID AS sales_post_id, sp.TITLE AS sales_post_title, sp.DESCRIPTION AS sales_post_description, sp.CREATED_DATE, sp.LAST_POST_DATE, sp.UPDATED_DATE, sp.START_POST_DATE, sp.STATUS, md.max_discount_amount AS DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, dc.DISCOUNT_TYPE, dc.DISCOUNT_VALUE, dc.MIN_PRICE, (p.PRICE - md.max_discount_amount) AS DISCOUNTED_PRICE, -- 할인된 가격 c.NAME AS category_name, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.NEXT_VAL FROM PRODUCT_TB p LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_FILE_TB pf ON p.PRODUCT_NUMBER = pf.PRODUCT_NUMBER LEFT JOIN SALES_POST_TB sp ON p.PRODUCT_NUMBER = sp.PRODUCT_NUMBER LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_CATEGORY_MAPPING_TB pcm ON p.PRODUCT_NUMBER = pcm.PRODUCT_NUMBER LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_CATEGORY_TB c ON pcm.CATEGORY_ID = c.ID LEFT JOIN max_discounts md ON p.PRODUCT_NUMBER = md.product_number LEFT JOIN discounted_products dc ON p.PRODUCT_NUMBER = dc.product_number AND md.max_discount_amount = CASE WHEN dc.DISCOUNT_TYPE = 'P' THEN p.PRICE * (dc.DISCOUNT_VALUE / 100) WHEN dc.DISCOUNT_TYPE = 'A' THEN dc.DISCOUNT_VALUE ELSE 0 END WHERE p.PRODUCT_NUMBER != #{productNumber} -- 현재 페이지의 상품 번호를 제외 AND c.CATEGORY_CODE = #{categoryCode} -- 특정 카테고리 조건 추가 AND sp.STATUS = 1 -- 판매글 상태가 '판매 중'인 경우만 ORDER BY p.CREATED_DATE DESC FETCH FIRST 6 ROWS ONLY
